_about: DR4-READY-1 release-day manifest TEMPLATE (new file). Fill every null BEFORE the data are opened (Amendments 15(d), 16(b)-(c)). Candidate names come from ESA's DRAFT DR4 data model (zip 2026-06-26, PDF issue D rev. 0 2026-05-20; data_assembly/DR4_DRAFT_DATAMODEL_COLUMNS_2026-09-29.md, aa9c48a9f) and the earlier web preview (d9ac3a13f). They are NOT binding: each is re-confirmed from the published DR4 data model on 2 Dec 2026. No cut value, threshold, estimator setting or decision row is set here.

nss_group._note: the ten tables of the draft's chapter 10 (A17 draft section 1); nss_epoch_flags is served by DataLink, not TAP

columns._rule: DR3 name used by the frozen build -> the DR4 table.column it is read from; confirm each before opening. dry_run_driver.py reads, per column: 'confirmed' (the table), 'join_file' (a local file with source_id + the column, joined by source_id when the base table lacks it), or 'unavailable': true with a 'reason' -- then the cut that reads it is reported UNIMPLEMENTABLE, disabled and flagged (Amendment 15(d)), never substituted

ruwe.candidate: gaia_source.ruwe (stays in gaia_source per the draft; also all_source_astrometry, nss_acceleration_astro)
ruwe.draft_note: the draft says astrometric_gof_al is probably more useful than ruwe from DR4 on; the frozen cut reads ruwe

ipd_frac_multi_peak.candidate: gaia_source.ipd_frac_multi_peak (stays per the draft; also all_source_astrometry)

radial_velocity.candidate: gaia_source.radial_velocity (stays per the draft, with radial_velocity_origin; all_source_rvs is the per-module table)

non_single_star.candidate: all_source_flags.non_single_star only (not in gaia_source per the draft)
non_single_star.use: not read for DR4: cut 12 is the nss_* union (cut12_nss)

cut9_extinction.variant_reported_only: an ap_* or total_galactic_extinction_map value, table and column to be named here before opening

variant_candidates.per_source: gaia_source.ag, gaia_source.ebpminrp with gaia_source.extinction_origin (consolidated); or ap_xp.ag_gspphot, ap_xp.ebpminrp_gspphot
variant_candidates.map: total_galactic_extinction_map (HEALPix, monochromatic A0; not per source)

cut12_nss._rule: declare counted_tables and a written reason for every excluded table BEFORE opening any id file (cut12_stub refuses otherwise). A two-source table (rows with source_id and source_id_secondary) must go through cut12_nss_union.run_a17, which searches both id columns; run() refuses it. Query text: cut12_nss_union.adql_nss(). Amendment 17 (filed, ab9557d58) fixes the reading: see 'a17_filed_ab9557d58'.

excluded.nss_epoch_flags: DataLink-only, not TAP; per-transit flags with a model label, no solution parameters (A17 (a))

a17_filed_ab9557d58._status: Amendment 17 is FILED, on the owner's explicit go: ab9557d58 (prereg sha256 97aa97c4 -> 7fd0b36b; AMENDMENT17_HASH.txt). cut12_nss_union.run_a17 with the reading 'A17_primary' is the binding cut-12 reading; V17a and V17b are reported variants (A17 (c)). Table names: draft 2026-06-26, confirm on release day. The stored solution_type strings of nss_resolved_pair are NOT printed in the draft: record them in 'solution_types_recorded' on release day, BEFORE opening any id file (A17 (d)); run_a17 raises until they are recorded.

solution_types_recorded_on_release_day.nss_resolved_pair: record the stored strings on release day, before opening (A17 (d)); the draft names ResolvedPairFixed, ResolvedPairLinear, ResolvedPairAcceleration, ResolvedPairJerk, DiverseAcceleration, DiverseJerk

excluded.nss_epoch_flags: DataLink-only, not TAP; per-transit flags with a model label, no solution parameters (A17 (a))

cut13_third_star.primary: literal (Amendment 16(b)): dpar < 3 sigma, dmu < 5 sigma_dmu, G < 20, 30 kAU of either component

_hazard: the frozen builder overwrites its correlation cache instead of merging: give each base its own cache path

every_dr4_name_here: a candidate from the draft data model (2026-06-26; aa9c48a9f) or the web preview (d9ac3a13f): CONFIRM ON RELEASE DAY
